name: Spellbound Gown
description: This gown is bound with powerful spells to protect the mage from harm.

name: Brightsong Torc
description: This torc is detailed with carved dragons whose eyes are set with tiny, glittering jewels.

name: Helm of the Wanderer
description: A helm made of mystical entwined oak which surrounds the wearer with a formidable defence.

name: Fiona's Necklace
description: This simple necklace belies the power contained within it.

name: DNU
description: This weapon requires both hands to use.

name: Una's Fur Boots
description: These boots are hand made from wolf fur, and are very warm and comfy. They grant you 10 cold resistance.

name: Declan's Ring
description: This ring is engraved with Celtic script, describing enchantments that protect the wearer from harm.

name: Severina's Amulet
description: This amulet comprises a glass vial on a silver chain. The dark liquid in the vial can be smelt even through the cork stopper. The smell makes you feel lethargic, but incredibly resilient.

name: Una's Fur Gloves
description: These gloves are lined with soft fur to keep your hands warm in cold weather. They grant you 5 cold resistance.

name: Winter Warmer
description: The fur that this scarf is made from is mottled grey and white, and the hairs seem to shimmer as they blow in the wind. It will keep out the cold even on the most bitter of winter mornings.

name: Zeuk's Gloves
description: These gloves were owned by Zeuk the Mage, who was captured by the Crookbacks.  They give the user a slight boost in magical ability.

name: Corbin's Bracers
description: These bracers were owned by Corbin the Ranger, who was captured by the Crookbacks.  They allow arrows, daggers, and other piercing weapons to fly straight and true.

name: Kayla's Gauntlets
description: These gauntlets were owned by Kayla the Warrior, who was captured by the Crookbacks.  They have been reinforced with pieces of plate metal for extra protection.

name: Ring of the Trinity Servant
description: This ring is made of carved onyx inset with silver. Something about it makes you feel uneasy, but the enchantments placed upon it are undeniably powerful.

name: Yellowed Canine
description: This tooth could conceivably be used to fashion some basic jewellery.

name: Grey Wolf Pelt
description: This pelt is grey in colour, and is found on the many wolves that inhabit Lir's Reach.

name: Silver Axe of Carnage
description: This deadly axe is wielded in the off hand, and has been specially made for the most aggressive heroes.

name: Golden Axe of Carnage
description: This devastating axe is wielded in the off hand, and has been specially made for the most aggressive of heroes.

name: Silver Mace of Virtue
description: This mighty mace is wielded in the off hand, and has been specially made for the most virtuous of heroes.

name: Bronze Brooch
description: A decorative brooch made from bronze. The craftsmanship is basic, but not unattractive.

name: Golden Mace of Virtue
description: This mighty mace is wielded in the off hand, and has been specially made for the most virtuous of heroes.

name: Horn Goblet
description: Carved from the horns of mighty beasts, these Horn Goblets are favoured by the Skullcrushers. [00CC00]Hogan the Barkeep[-], will be interested in this. He can be found in the [FF9900]Tavern[-].

name: Claws of the Alpha Snarl
description: These sharp claws belonged to the Alpha Snarl. A fearsome beast, but no match for you!

name: Sacred Finger of Pontificus
description: These bones once belonged to Pontificus the Obstinate, a well-known and revered monk of Belenus.

name: Arrows
description: These simple arrows add no bonus to damage or range, but do not run out.

name: Command Totem
description: This unsightly totem is made from an animal's skull mounted on a wooden haft.

name: Commendation Scroll
description: This scroll is sealed with wax and stamped with the symbol of Clan MacLir.

name: Military Supplies
description: This bag contains assorted supplies destined for the Clan MacLir soldiers. This item would be of interest to [00CC00]Faolan MacLir[-].

name: Bottle of Mead
description: This mead carries the delicate flavour of the heather that covers the hills of East Dal Riata.

name: Farcrag Sewers Map
description: This map has rough plans of the Farcrag Castle cellars drawn upon it. [00CC00]Boris Shadowhand[-] is interested in this, he's in [FF9900]Crookback Hollow[-].

name: Red Rooster
description: This red rooster is happy for you to pick it up.

name: Marsh Brown
description: This brown chicken is content to sit quietly in your backpack.

name: Black Dumpy
description: This black chicken is happy for you to pick it up.

name: Barbed Silver Arrowhead
description: This silver arrowhead sparkles in the light, and you fancy you can feel it vibrating in your hand, as if it has a life of its own.

name: Common Chicken
description: This white chicken is content to sit quietly in your backpack.

name: White Pawn
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: White Knight
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: White Bishop
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: White Rook
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: White Queen
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: White King
description: An ornate chess piece, carved from walrus ivory.

name: Bracken the Puppy
description: This adorable puppy has soft fur and a shiny black nose.  He wags his tail when you pick him up.

name: Necklace of Energy
description: This pendant is wrought from silver, and set with a glittering blue gem.

name: Strange Letter
description: This letter is written in a strange hand of thick, angular shapes. Whoever wrote it, you cannot read their language.

name: Wolf Meat
description: Although it's no-one's favourite meal, an inventive chef can turn this wolf meat into an edible stew.

name: Skullcrusher Signal Torch
description: These torches are used by the Skullcrushers to signal to their offshore longboats.

name: Rafferty's Ring
description: This engagement ring is intended for Rafferty's beloved Morag. Whether it will ever get to her is another matter.

name: Mining Pick
description: The fine points of this pick have been blunted slightly in the inexpert hands of the Crookbacks.

name: Tomb Shovel
description: These shovels are small enough to be concealed within one's clothing, making it perfect for a grave robber.

name: Mugwort
description: This plant has a number of medicinal and magical properties, and is sometimes used to flavour drinks.

name: Thyme
description: As well as its culinary uses, this flavoursome and aromatic plant can also be used in the treatment of wounds.

name: Nettle
description: While the stinging hairs on its leaves may ward off many, this plant has a variety of medicinal uses.

name: Rotten Flesh
description: This piece of rotting flesh has been taken from the undead Acolytes of Donn. The odour it exudes is foul beyond words, and you don't wish to carry it for long.

name: Ancient Bone Shards
description: The yellow discolouration on these crumbling fragments of bone is a testament to their extreme age.

name: Crookback Jail Key
description: This heavy iron key opens the door to the Crookback Jail.

name: Figurine of Belenus
description: This is a small figurine of Belenus, the Celtic god of the sun. The figurine is carved from local stone, and is quite exquisite. [00CC00]Blind Old Erskine[-], in the Tavern, would be interested in this Figurine.

name: Saltfire Brew
description: This is a dark, bitter drink, reportedly made by the Crookbacks in a great cauldron. It is heavily intoxicating and highly illegal. As such, it's in great demand. [00CC00]Blind Old Erskine[-], in the Tavern, would be interested in this Brew.

name: Mysterious Egg
description: This strange egg is large and covered in dust, giving the impression that it has existed for a long time without hatching. Quite what would emerge if it ever did hatch, you couldn't say.

name: Contraband
description: This bag contains various minor items of contraband, but nothing of any great value.

description: Taken from a Frostfang Wolf, this sharp canine is strangely cold to the touch.  It sparkles and shines when you hold it up to the light.

name: Training Bow
description: This is a very basic bow, suitable for teaching the fundamentals of archery, but not recommended for battle.

name: Clover
description: This common plant has broad, flat leaves.

name: Maelcum's Skull
description: This is the skull of Maelcum Mathanach of Clan Mathanach, who was ambushed and killed by King Grotspew Crookback ten years ago.

name: Mathanach Claymore
description: This sword is a gift from Clan Mathanach. Though powerful, it is slow, and leaves the wielder open to attack. It requires both hands to use.

name: Mathanach Bow
description: This bow is a gift from Clan Mathanach. Though powerful, it is slow, and leaves the wielder open to attack.

name: Silver Orb of Energy
description: This silver orb pulses with the energy bestowed upon it by a powerful foreign sorceress.

description: This is a piece of the tunic of a soldier of Connacht. It is in poor condition.

name: Tarnished Connacht Armour Piece

name: Connacht Chainmail Piece
description: This is a piece of the chainmail armour of a soldier of Connacht.

name: Connacht Brooch
description: This brooch belonged to one of the invading Connachta soldiers. The craftsmanship is basic, but not unattractive.

name: Connacht Torc
description: This torc has been taken one of the invading Connachta soldiers. The heavy bronze is inlaid with detailed patterns.

name: Connacht Goblet
description: This attractive goblet came from one of the invading Connachta soldiers. It is decorative as well as functional.

name: Connacht Silver Ring
description: This silver ring once belonged to a soldier of Connacht. The intricate, spiralling designs are a testament to the work that went into it.

name: Connacht Gold Ring
description: This beautiful gold ring once belonged to a soldier of Connacht. Finely detailed designs are etched into the metal, along with writing in a strange, foreign hand.

name: Officer's Pin
description: This small badge denotes the status of a Captain of the army of Connacht.

name: Symbol of Mac Roth
description: The jewel in this pendant is engraved with the symbol of Lord Mac Roth, and displays the oaths of obedience the wearer has taken to him.

name: Symbol of Medb
description: The jewel in this pendant is engraved with the symbol of Queen Medb of Connacht, and is symbolic of the vows of servitude the wearer has taken to her.

name: Connacht Bronze Ring
description: This bronze ring once belonged to a soldier of Connacht. Although basic, its beauty lies in its simplicity.

name: Slayer's Golden Baselard
description: This long dagger is wielded in the off hand, and is specially made for the most dangerous rogues.

name: Golden Orb of Power
description: This magical orb resonates with power. Legend has it that it was created by an ancient mage-king who lived in the mists over the northern sea.

name: Silver Helm of the Berserker
description: This silver helm was worn by a long line of Norse berserkers, and imparts upon the wearer some of their battle-rage.

name: Golden Helm of Bloodlust
description: This golden helm fills the wearer with the red rage of battle allowing them to do more damage per hit. It is said that it once belonged to a mighty Norse warlord.

name: Harbinger Ritual Blade
description: A tiny metal blade which is given to a Connacht Harbinger once he has passed his right of ascension into adulthood.

name: Spoils of Battle
description: A piece of cloth torn from the Connacht's enemies to prove they were beaten in battle.

name: Ternstone
description: A small and rather unremarkable stone. Its exterior has been smoothed through age and use.

name: Glumstump's Shackle Key
description: This key belonged to the Connacht Prison Guard, Glumstump.

name: Ruffcramp's Shackle Key
description: This key belonged to the Connacht Prison Guard, Ruffcramp.

name: Darrion's Letter
description: "A letter found on the body of the treacherous Ranger Darrion. It reads: ""Darrion. Lead the scouts to their death, then return to me for your orders. C."""

name: Gannon's Letter
description: "A letter found on the body of Marshal Gannon. It reads: ""My brothers - Cullen, Gannon and Luther. Soon we shall be reunited, and the long years of hurt and loyalty will be repaid in full. Mac Roth."""

name: Luther's Head
description: The head of Luther, the betrayer of Clan MacCroin.

name: Bronze Amulet of Regeneration
description: This bronze amulet was once the possession of a powerful warrior from the Highlands. It regenerates the wearer's health by five points per tick, even in combat.

name: Heroic Amulet of Regeneration
description: This shining amulet has been empowered by the most powerful rituals of the high druids. It regenerates the wearer's health by twenty points per tick, even in combat.

name: Bronze Amulet of Energisation
description: This bronze amulet was once owned by a wise wandering sage. It regenerates the wearer's energy by five points per tick, even in combat.

name: Heroic Amulet of Energisation
description: This glowing amulet has been imbued with magic by the most potent spells of the arch mages. It regenerates the wearer's energy by twenty points per tick, even in combat.

name: Bronze Amulet of Rejuvenation
description: This bronze amulet is said to be an heirloom of the ancient kings of Dal Riata. It regenerates both the wearer's health and energy by five points per tick, even in combat.

name: Heroic Amulet of Rejuvenation
description: This dazzling amulet regenerates both the wearer's health and energy by twenty points per tick, even in combat.

name: Bolt Thrower

name: Thunderclap Cleaver

name: Perilous Heart

name: Wall of Eternity

name: Rod of Blessings

name: Blade of Duty
description: This well-balanced sword allows the bearer to destroy their foes with deadly attacks, but leaves them vulnerable to elemental damage.

name: Nullifier

name: Blindside

name: Snowflake Ring
description: This ring was given to you by Janet Kelso in Stonevale. It is slightly cold to the touch, though not unpleasantly so. This ring is unique and cannot be equipped with others of the same type.

name: Hearthstone Ring
description: This ring was given to you by Janet Kelso in Stonevale. When you wear it, you fancy you can hear voices whispering to you in a lilting, forgotten tongue. This ring is unique and cannot be equipped with others of the same type.

name: Primal Relic Serpentstaff
description: This, the third rarest Serpentstaff, was once held by chieftains and kings. It increases movement speed by 90% and grants 30% camouflage. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Legendary Relic Serpentstaff
description: This, the second rarest Serpentstaff, was once held by chieftains and kings. It increases movement speed by 95% and grants 40% camouflage. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Mythic Relic Serpentstaff
description: This, the rarest of all Serpentstaffs, was once held by chieftains and kings. It increases movement speed by 100% and grants 50% camouflage. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Minstrel's Flute
description: This is the most common type of flute.  It has been crafted from fine local wood, and when equipped, it plays a rousing tune that increases your out of combat health regeneration by 10 points per tick. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Bard's Flute
description: The rarest type of flute has been masterfully crafted of burnished gold. It plays a rousing tune increasing your out of combat health regeneration by 50 points per tick. Grants the 'Jaunty Melody' skill. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Wolf Pelt
description: This pelt is grey in colour, and is found on the many wolves that inhabit Lir's Reach.

name: Charred Wyrmclaw
description: A grimy claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  It is in poor condition and will fetch the lowest price for its kind and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Singed Wyrmclaw
description: A singed claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  It is in bad condition and will fetch the lowest price for its kind and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Rough Wyrmclaw
description: A rough claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  It is in poor condition slightly reducing its value and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Smooth Wyrmclaw
description: A smooth claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  It is in poor condition and will fetch the lowest price for its kind and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Pristine Wyrmclaw
description: A pristine claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  Its rarity ensures that it will fetch a fine price and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Enchanted Wyrmclaw
description: An enchated claw from the scaled foot of a Wyrm.  It is the rarest and most valuable of its kind and is a symbol of victory in battle.

name: Stolen MacCroin Ring
description: This simple yet elegant ring belonged to a man or woman of Clan MacCroin before it was taken by the Connacht. The MacCroins are keen to see it returned to its rightful owner.

description: This pretty brooch has been stolen by the Connacht from Clan MacCroin. The MacCroins are keen to see it returned to its rightful owner.

description: This goblet was once used in MacCroin feasts before it was looted by the Connacht. The MacCroins are keen to see it returned to its rightful owner.

name: Stolen MacCroin Idol
description: This idol was once the favoured possession of a family of Clan MacCroin, who would place it in their home to ensure a bountiful harvest. The MacCroins are keen to see it returned to its rightful owner.

name: Corrupted Fang
description: This tusk is pitted with corrosion, and is covered with dark stains. Elwen the Scholar may be interested in studying this item.

description: This unusual stone once formed the core of a wisp. Elwen the Scholar may be interested in studying this item.

name: Corrupted Unicorn Horn
description: This unicorn horn is dry and shrivelled, with a sickly hue. Elwen the Scholar may be interested in studying this item.

name: Bloodgrove Grimoire
description: The pages of this tome are marked with strange symbols, some of which seem to be written in dried blood. Elwen the Scholar may be interested in studying this item.

name: Enchanted Leaf
description: This enchanted leaf is burned in a Ritual of Elocation and reveals where a lost loves soul has been taken. Heather Campbell, in the Otherworld, is seeking this item.

name: Captured Soul
description: This captured soul is freed in the Ritual of Elocation to ask Branwen to grant a lost soul from Dal Riata can return. Heather Campbell, in the Otherworld, is seeking this item.

name: Golden Apple
description: This golden apple is eaten in the Ritual of Elocation and draws a lost soul towards their greatest love. Heather Campbell, in the Otherworld, is seeking this item.

name: Living Amber
description: This living amber is used as incense in a Ritual of Elocation, binding a lost soul to their greatest love. Heather Campbell, in the Otherworld, is seeking this item.

name: Crystalline Nexus
description: This crystaline nexus is crushed in the Ritual of Elocation to call on Branwen to return a trapped soul to their body. Heather Campbell, in the Otherworld, is seeking this item.

description: The Crowspine Skirr of Nightmares increases your movement speed by 90%. It was seized from defeated Yoch Darach warriors by the Riders of Epona.  Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Scroll of the Locus
description: This scroll shows where the Locus of The Otherworld is but without the Status and Nebulous scrolls it is a worthless scrap of parchment.

name: Scroll of the Status
description: This scroll shows the Status of The Otherworld but without the Locus and Nebulous scrolls it is a worthless scrap of parchment.

name: Scroll of the Nebulous
description: This scroll shows the Nebulous nature of The Otherworld but without the scrolls of Status and Locus it is a worthless scrap of parchment.

name: Disrupted Stone
description: This stone was once set in a piece of jewellery but now simply bears the marks of where it was forced from its surround.

name: Broken Surround
description: This surround once held a stone and was attached to a mighty chain but these items have been wrenched from its body.

name: Mighty Chain
description: This chain used to be attached to a piece of jewellery which seems to have been torn assunder by rough hands.

name: Ancient Jewelry
description: This is one of the Targair. An ancient reward from the gods which was passed to those humans who excelled. However its purpose has changed.

name: Element of Fire
description: The true element of fire. These elements are sought by all those who practice magic and provide a pure source for spells.

name: Element of Water
description: The true element of water. These elements are sought by all those who practice magic and provide a pure source for spells.

name: Element of Air
description: The true element of air. These elements are sought by all those who practice magic and provide a pure source for spells.

name: Element of Earth
description: The true element of earth. These elements are sought by all those who practice magic and provide a pure source for spells.

name: Dull Ophidian Ring
description: This ring is said to protect the user from a Serpents Sting but some element seems to be missing.

name: Serpents Blood
description: The vile blood of a sea serpent which is oft used in ritual magic.

name: Obsidian Dragon Egg
description: The egg of the obsidian dragon, which is thought to have disappeared from our shores aeons hence.

name: Cursed Coin of Dunskeig
description: The coin of a lost soul who was put to death in the Citadel of Dunskeig during the Age of Chaos.

name: Gorn Toad Toxin
description: The frightful toxin of a Gorm Toad, which is meant to have strange abilities when used by scryers.

name: Tensile Silk
description: The silk from a sewer spider which is used by users of magic to create a safe web around their target.

name: Murk Vine
description: The Murk Vine glows with an odd luminescence.

name: Silt Flower
description: The Silt Flower glows with an odd luminescence.

name: Grime Blossom
description: The Grime Blossom glows with an odd luminescence.

name: Vault Plans
description: Plans of the Murky Vaults which have been drawn up by adventurers.

name: Vault Notes
description: Notes about the Murky Vaults and its denizens which have been written by an exploring scribe.

name: Vault Map
description: A rudimentary map of the Murky Vaults which was scratched down by an inquisitive treasure hunter.

name: Warrant of Stature
description: The medallion of a Firbolg leader. The warrant is scratched across its surface with their writings and represents the stature of the tribe.

name: Warrant of Bloodoath
description: The medallion of a Firbolg leader. The warrant is scratched across its surface with their writings and represents the bloodoath of the tribe.

name: Warrant of Deceit
description: The medallion of a Firbolg leader. The warrant is scratched across its surface with their writings and represents the deceit of the tribe.

name: Toadstool of Rot
description: A toadstool that grows in the corrupted lands of The Otherworld.

name: Fungus of the Wasteland
description: A fungus that grows in the corrupted lands of The Otherworld.

name: Mushroom of Despair
description: A mushroom that grows in the corrupted lands of The Otherworld.

name: Corrupted Oak Apples
description: The strange bulbous seed that sometimes spawns on the corrupted dryads of The Otherworld.

name: Soul of the Wandering Soldier
description: The distressed soul of a soldier who was trapped and died in the Murky Vaults.

name: Emblem of Fingal
description: The emblem is said to have been used as a token by Fingal himself when making judgements with his fellow heroes.

name: Emblem of Dian Cecht
description: The emblem is said to have been used as a token by Dian Cecht himself when making judgements with his fellow heroes.

description: The emblem is said to have been used as a token by Myrrdin himself when making judgements with his fellow heroes.

name: Emblem of Cuhcullain
description: The emblem is said to have been used as a token by Cuhcullain himself when making judgements with his fellow heroes.

description: The Omphalic Stone is from the Targair granted to Scathach herself but has been torn from the surround and chain.

name: Gilded Surround
description: The Gilded Surround is from the Targair granted to Scathach herself but has been torn from the stone and chain.

name: Chain of Instruction
description: The Chain of Instruction is from the Targair granted to Scathach herself but has been torn from the surround and stone.

name: The Targair of Scathach
description: The Targair of the first Head of the Wardens. It is awash with ancient energy and courses with the power of the gods.

name: Kelpie Horn
description: The horn from a corrupted kelpie in The Otherworld.

name: Otherworld Poppy
description: A strange plant that seems to have been touched by the corruption of The Otherworld.

name: Hallow Weed
description: A weed that can be found in The Otherworld, near the swamp.

name: Yanack Stone
description: A stone that can be found in The Otherworld, near the swamp.

name: Binding Webs
description: A tough form of webbing that can be used to bind armour and weapons.

name: Echocap Mushroom
description: A type of mushroom that grows on the dirt in the maze of shafts to the north of Carrowmore.

name: Redblood Mushroom
description: A type of mushroom that grows on the dirt in the maze of shafts to the north of Carrowmore.

name: Coldfall Mushroom
description: A type of mushroom that grows on the dirt in the maze of shafts to the north of Carrowmore.

name: Summoning Stones
description: The stones left after a Summoning Wraith is defeated. They are said to have mystical power.

name: Ironrock
description: The ore from an ironrock golem.

name: Obsidian Ironrock
description: A more valuable ore from an ironrock golem.

name: Ironrock Bracelet
description: A rough hewn bracelet formed from the ore of the ironrock golems. This bracelet grants Iron Barrier to those that wear it, protecting against the Soul Drain of the Bridge Sentinel.

name: Tome of the Wardens
description: A tome which was held by the first warden until they were split in twain by the corruption of Crom.

name: Rod of the Wardens
description: A rod which was held by the first warden until they were split in twain by the corruption of Crom.

name: Livery of the Wardens
description: A great necklace which was held by the first warden until they were split in twain by the corruption of Crom.

name: Bleak

name: Catfish
description: A delicious meal for accomplished anglers when correctly prepared, Catfish are long, whiskered fish native to the waters of Stonevale. They are sighted uncommonly around Stonevale Farm. It weighs 8 pounds.

name: Salmon
description: A delicious meal for accomplished anglers when correctly prepared, Salmon are leaping freshwater fish native to the waters of Stonevale. They are sighted uncommonly around the Southern Dales. It weighs 9 pounds.

name: Bullhead
description: A large, broad headed fish. Bullhead are native to the waters of Fingal's Cave. They are most commonly sighted in the river within the cave. It weighs 7 pounds.

name: Stickleback
description: A small fish with spines along it's back. Stickleback are native to the waters of Fingal's Cave. They are most commonly sighted in the river within the cave. It weighs 1 pound.

name: Rockfish
description: A bulky fish with hardened scales. Rockfish are native to the waters of Fingal's Cave. They are most commonly sighted around Loch Dorcha. It weighs 13 pounds.

name: Mullet
description: A slim, swift fish. Mullets are native to the waters of Fingal's Cave. They are most commonly sighted around Loch Dorcha. It weighs 2 pounds.

name: Cave Fish

name: Bull Shark
description: This rare fish is highly sought by gourmands who wish to cook the finest recipes ever known. Only a master angler is capable of catching a powerful creature such as this. It weighs 30 pounds.

name: Auroral Trout
description: This legendary Trout's scales shimmer with bursts of multicoloured light, putting on a beautiful and mystifying display. It is said to have been brought into existence by Nodens, the God of Fishing, as a reminder to anglers of the beauty of their craft.

name: Aether Pike
description: This legendary Pike has a pale blue aura surrounding it and sometimes appears to be in two places at once. It is said to have been brought into existence by Nodens, the God of Fishing, as a challenge to anglers the world over.

name: Astral Ray
description: This legendary ray appears to be blanketed with constantly shifting stars and constellations. It is said to have been brought into existence by Nodens, the God of Fishing, with the intent of inspiring anglers to fish far and wide.

name: Rimecap Mushroom
description: A special mushroom that only grows in Fingal's Cave. There is a thin layer of frost covering this mushroom, keeping it pleasantly chilled.

name: MacCroin Supplies
description: A chest of supplies stolen from the MacCroin by the Connacht.

name: Shalemont Foxglove
description: A rare flower that blooms only in Shalemont Ravine. Used for various alchemical marvels.

name: Red Herring
description: A rare red fish found only in the waters of Lir's Reach. Red Herring can be sighted rarely around Lir's Pier and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 5 pounds.

name: Summer Flounder
description: A rare flounder found only in the waters of Lir's Reach. Summer Flounder can be sighted rarely around Lir's Pier and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 6 pounds.

name: Silver Whiting
description: A whiting with shimmering silver scales, found only in the waters of Lir's Reach. Silver Whiting can be sighted rarely around the Northern Peninsula, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 5 pounds.

name: King Mackerel
description: A massive, imposing species of Mackerel found only in the waters of Lir's Reach. King Mackerel can be sighted rarely around Highshore Village, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 9 pounds.

name: Redeye Barbel
description: A rare species of Barbel with red eyes found only in the lakes and rivers of Shalemont Ravine. Redeye Barbel can be sighted rarely around the MacCroin Camp and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 5 pounds.

name: Silver Carp
description: A gleaming silver carp found only in the lakes and rivers of Shalemont Ravine. Silver Carp can be sighted rarely around Shalemont Lake and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 11 pounds.

name: Prized Pike
description: A massive, Prized Pike of this size can only be found in the lakes and rivers of Shalemont Ravine. Prized Pike can be sighted rarely in Greygorge River, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 8 pounds.

name: Golden Trout
description: A glittering golden species of Trout found only in the waters of Stonevale. Golden Trout can be sighted rarely around Stonevale Lake, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 12 pounds.

name: Giant Catfish
description: A giant, whiskered Catfish found only in the waters of Stonevale. Giant Catfish can be sighted rarely around Stonevale Farm, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 15 pounds.

name: King Salmon
description: A massive, high quality Salmon found only in the waters of Stonevale. King Salmon can be sighted rarely around the Southern Dales, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 18 pounds.

name: Giant Eel
description: A particularly large species of Eel found only in the waters of Fingal's Cave. Giant Eels can be sighted rarely in the river within the cave, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 28 pounds.

name: Prized Plaice
description: An unusually large Plaice found only in the waters of Fingal's Cave. Prized Plaice can be sighted rarely in the river within the cave, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 9 pounds.

name: Albino Cave Fish
description: A peculiar species unique to the waters of Fingal's Cave. Albino Cave Fish can be sighted rarely around Loch Dorcha, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 8 pounds.

name: Prized Haddock
description: A huge species of Haddock found only in the waters of Fingal's Cave. Prized Haddock can be sighted rarely around Loch Dorcha, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 11 pounds.

name: King Morthar
description: A brightly gleaming offshoot of the Morthar Fish found only in the waters of the Otherworld. King Morthar can be sighted rarely in the river by the fortress of Rath Parras, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 43 pounds.

name: Eagle Ray
description: A beautifully majestic stingray found only in the waters of Dunskeig. Eagle Rays can be sighted rarely around the Central Viaduct, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 30 pounds.

name: Starry Dogfish
description: A rare species of dogfish that appears to have brightly shining stones integrated with it's scales. Starry Dogfish are native to the waters of the Murky Vaults and can be sighted rarely around the Lower Cistern. It weighs 30 pounds.

name: King Angler
description: A fierce angler fish that only a master angler could hook, native to the waters of Carrowmore Tunnels. King Anglers can be sighted rarely in the Pool of Bolg, and are highly sought after by many. It weighs 47 pounds.

name: Nimble Windwalker
description: This Nimble Windwalker is of an ancient, mystical lineage. This mount will boost your movement speed by 75% and health and energy regen by 20.

name: Fleet Clouddancer
description: This Fleet Clouddancer is of an ancient, mystical lineage. This mount will boost your movement speed by 80% and health and energy regen by 30.

name: Swift Skybreaker
description: This Swift Skybreaker is of an ancient, mystical lineage. This mount will boost your movement speed by 85%, health and energy regen by 40 and camouflage by 40%.

name: Elegant Moonstrider
description: This Elegant Moonstrider is of an ancient, mystical lineage. This mount will boost your movement speed by 90% health and energy regen by 50 and camouflage by 50%.

name: Spirited Nimble Windwalker
description: This Spirited Nimble Windwalker is clad in the armour of an ancient order. This mount will boost your movement speed by 85% and health and energy regen by 60.

name: Spirited Fleet Clouddancer
description: This Spirited Fleet Clouddancer is clad in the armour of an ancient order. Boosts your movement speed by 90% and health and energy regen by 70. Grants the skill 'Gallop' which boosts your speed by an extra 10% for 20 seconds. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Spirited Swift Skybreaker
description: This Spirited Swift Skybreaker is clad in the armour of an ancient order. Boosts your movement speed by 95% and health and energy regen by 80. Grants the skill 'Gallop' which boosts your speed by an extra 20% for 20 seconds. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Spirited Elegant Moonstrider
description: This Spirited Elegant Moonstrider is clad in the armour of an ancient order. Boosts your movement speed by 100% and health and energy regen by 90. Grants the skill 'Gallop' which boosts your speed by an extra 30% for 20 seconds. Uses Novelty Ability.

name: Hawkhurst Poison
description: A vial of dangerous poison being used by the Hawkhurst. It seems to be made from Onyx and contains a sharp smelling liquid.

name: Coldshard Crystal
description: An icy cold fragment of crystal found growing in the southern tunnels of Dunskeig Sewers.

name: Blackstone Cache
description: A sealed cache taken from the Blackstone forces in the Dunskeig Sewers. It's sure to contain all manner of sinister items.

name: Crawler Mucus
description: A dose of mucus from the Crawlers that frequent the tunnels of Dunskeig Sewers, used frequently as a catalyst for fast acting poisons.

name: Manual of Many Toxins
description: A manual of toxins and poisons written by the Hawkhurst's chief poisoner, Drevin the Dreaded. This vile book would be incredibly dangerous in the wrong hands.

name: Crystal Laced Vial
description: A vial laced with purest crystal, used for potent alchemical concoctions.

name: Cadaverous Bloom
description: A foul smelling flower found growing from magically animated corpses. Used in alchemy related to death magicks.

name: Profane Bloom
description: An incredibly foul smelling flower that grows from corpses infused with powerful death magick. This rare bloom is much desired by alchemists of ill repute.

name: Vial of Deathmute
description: A malevolently glowing liquid contained within a crystal laced vial. Delph the Poisoner insists that this should reverse the effects of the dark poisons being used by the Hawkhurst.

name: Torn Journal
description: No matter how hard you try, you can't seem to read the words written on the pages of this journal. The letters dart away from your eyes in a dizzying display of magic. Perhaps Denwal will be able to make sense of this.

name: Mindtrap Shard
description: A smooth shard of glass that seems to contain a swirling inky substance. When you grip it tight and concentrate, you can feel the memories of others touching the edges of your mind.

name: Darkmind Core
description: A cluster of dark thoughts and malicious intentions given corporeal form by the Blackstone and their dark magicks.

name: Darkrune Chunk
description: A runed chunk of magically imbued stone taken from a fallen golem. The runes are like none you have seen before.

name: Maligath's Manuscript
description: A page of instructions written by Corruptor Maligath and given to one of his most devoted scions. It reveals the secrets to destroying Maligath's Opus.

name: Runebound Heartstone
description: A pulsing heartstone taken from Maligath's Opus. The runes on this object are intact and untouched, forming what seems to be an infinitely looping series of symbols.

name: Dragoncult Tome
description: The tome of a Dragoncult Taskmaster. It seems to contain many incomplete and flawed rituals regarding dragons and how to control them.

name: Scroll of Oak
description: A Scroll containing the sum total of the Blackstone's knowledge regarding the Seal of Oak. The information written on it is incredibly sparse.

name: Scroll of Elm
description: A scroll containing the sum total of the Blackstone's knowledge regarding the Seal of Elm. The information written on it is incredibly sparse.

name: Deathshard Crystal
description: A violently gleaming shard of crystal taken from one of the obelisks surrounding Corruptor Maligath.

name: Deathmute Ring
description: This ring pulses with a dark aura, and draws away the dark magick of the poisons used by the Blackstone Cabal in Dunskeig Sewers.

name: Empowered Deathmute Ring
description: This ring pulses with a dark aura, and draws away the dark magic of the poisons used by the Blackstone Cabal in Dunskeig Sewers. The infusion of Deathshard Crystals has made it even more effective at drawing in dark magick.

name: Exalted Deathmute Ring
description: This ring pulses with a dark aura, and draws away the dark magic of the poisons used by the Blackstone Cabal in Dunskeig Sewers. It has been blessed by Denwal the Warden, and has reached it's maximum potential.

name: Spoiled Meat
description: A bad cut of meat. Someone was probably going to throw this out.

name: Chum
description: A horrible, meaty gruel. You wouldn't want to eat it, but certain fish might.

name: Invasive Morthar
description: A strange fish that shimmers slightly in the light. It is not native to Stonevale, how it came to be here is a mystery. It weighs 16 pounds.

name: Clove of Garlic

name: Meringue

name: Gruel
description: A delicious bowl of Gruel, the first meal that any aspiring chef cooks. Eat to restore 20 energy.

name: Flat Bread
description: A basic yet tasty portion of flatbread, cooked just right! Eat to restore 20 health.

name: Broth
description: A satisfying bowl of Broth. This simple yet satisfying meal forms part of the daily rations for Lord MacLir's armies. Eat to restore 45 energy.

name: Bread
description: A soft yet perfectly crusty loaf of farmhouse bread, traditionally baked in Lir's Reach. Eat to restore 70 health.

name: Lentil Soup
description: A hearty soup, simple to make but difficult to perfect. Eat to restore 95 energy.

name: Oatcake
description: A different type of flatbread, more akin to a biscuit. Used as a part of the daily rations for Lord MacLir's armies. Eat to restore 120 health.

name: Pea Soup
description: A thick pea soup, a perfect warming meal for the harsh weather of Shalemont Ravine. Eat to restore 170 energy.

name: Scone
description: A freshly baked scone fresh from the ovens. It has a crumbly, cakey consistency. Eat to restore 220 health.

name: Pottage
description: A thickened stew made from boiled vegetables and grains. It is a staple food amongst the denizens of Dal Riata. Eat to restore 270 energy.

name: Ginger Bread
description: A tasty, baked biscuit flavoured with spices, traditionally baked during holiday seasons. Eat to restore 320 health.

name: Scotch Broth
description: A filling stew, and a speciality of the Smuggler's Rest Tavern in Lir's Reach. Eat to restore 370 energy.

name: Shortbread
description: A traditional celtic biscuit made with a combination of sugar, butter and flour. Farcrag shortbread is renouned throughout Dal Riata for being one of the finest treats in the realms! Eat to restore 420 health.

name: Carrot Soup
description: This rich orange soup is a favourite of the workers in the MacLir mining camp in Fingal's Cave, who claim it sharpens their eyesight in the dim conditions. Eat to restore 470 energy.

name: Pancake
description: A delicious baked treat that can be eaten as part of a sweet or savoury meal. Eat to restore 520 health.

name: Frumenty
description: While not much to look at, this meal is incredibly robust and filling, a favourite of survivalists who want to make ingredients stretch. Eat to restore 570 energy.

name: Flapjack
description: A sweet tray-bake made from a variety of natural ingredients. Apparently Lord MacLir is particularly partial to well made Flapjacks. Eat to restore 620 health.

name: Sweet Porridge
description: A simple, yet wholesome breakfast. The porridge served in the Smuggler's Rest Tavern in Lir's Reach is the best you'll find in all of Dal Riata. Eat to restore 670 energy.

name: Bannock
description: A traditional celtic style of flatbread, bannocks are usually cut and served as wedges of the whole confection. Eat to restore 720 health.

name: Mushroom Casserole
description: A complex but delicious meal made from combining edible mushrooms with other delicious ingredients. Eat to restore 770 energy.

name: Fruit Cake
description: A loaf of tastefully browned fruitcake, full of a mixture of various dried fruits. Eat to restore 820 health.

name: Rabbit Pie
description: A succulent pie. Eat to boost your maximum Health by 50 and regenerate 10 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Roast Beef
description: A classic, hearty meal. Eat to boost Slashing Damage by 18 and regenerate 20 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Venison Stew
description: Filled with tender meat. Eat to boost Heat, Cold and Magic Resist by 50 and regenerate 30 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Black Pudding
description: A spicy blood sausage. Eat to boost Attack by 210 and regenerate 40 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Boar Roast
description: A whole roasted boar. Eat to boost Armour by 90 and regenerate 50 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Rare Fruit Salad
description: A mix of juicy fruits from the Dryads in the Otherworld. Eat to boost Heat, Cold and Magic Resist by 110 and regenerate 60 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Warbeast Omelette
description: An acquired taste. Eat to boost Max Health by 650 and regenerate 70 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Wyvern Egg Souffle
description: A eggy dish with a spicy flair. Eat to boost all primary Attributes by 60 and regenerate 80 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Lamb Casserole
description: A simple, tasty dish. Eat to boost Armour by 20 and regenerate 10 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Cheese Rarebit
description: Melted cheese on toast. Eat to boost Defence by 120 and regenerate 20 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Cream of Pea Soup
description: Extra-creamy pea soup. Eat to boost Max Health by 300 and regenerate 30 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Cream of Carrot Soup
description: Extra-creamy carrot soup. Eat to boost all primary Attributes by 30 and regenerate 40 energy per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Spinach Pancake
description: High in iron! Eat to boost Crushing Damage by 60 and regenerate 50 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Granola
description: A sweet, crunchy snack. Eat to boost Attack by 360 and regenerate 60 health per tick for 5 minutes. You can only gain the effect of one type of food at a time.

name: Sweet Roll

name: Lesser Potion of Reaver's Resilience
description: The least potent Reaver's Resiliance potion provided to those friendly with the Reavers. This potion will reduce the effects of Lichborne Presence by 80%.

name: Potion of Reaver's Resilience
description: A medium strength Reaver's Resiliance potion provided to those deemed as dignified by the Reavers. This potion will reduce the effects of Lichborne Presence by 90%.

name: Enhanced Potion of Reaver's Resilience
description: A strong Reaver's Resiliance potion provided to those with an illustrious relationship with the Reavers. This potion will reduce the effects of Lichborne Presence by 95%.

name: Lich Treasure Trove

name: Vial of 'Absolute Agony'
description: A vial of deadly, pure poison, retrieved from Dark Harvester Vex in the Corrupted Gardens. This should be delivered to Warden Arlen before it falls into the wrong hands!

name: Superior Potion of Reaver's Resilience
description: The strongest Reaver's Resilience potion reserved for those who bear High Warlord status. This will completely negate the effects of Lichborne Presence. *Be warned, this may also have unwanted negative side effects when consumed.*

name: Superior Acuity of the Lich Potion
description: The strongest Acuity of the Lich potion reserved for those who bear Grand Vizier status. This will completely negate the effects of Reavers Oppression. *Be warned, this may also have unwanted negative side effects when consumed.*

name: Barding of the Reaver
description: This barding is reserved for those who show true to commitment to the Reavers. While they no longer need warhorses in their twisted form, they still reserve such barding for those honoured in their ranks.

name: Barding of the Lich
description: This barding is reserved for those who show true to commitment to the Lichborne. While they no longer need warhorses in their twisted form, they still reserve such barding for those honoured in their ranks.

name: Volatile Barding of the Reaver
description: This barding is reserved for those who show true to commitment to the Reavers. It contains a vestige of High Warlord Auraxis' power that embodies the Resilience of the Reavers.

name: Runic Barding of the Lich
description: This barding is reserved for those who show true to commitment to the Lichborne. It is imbued with a powerful arcane enchantment by Archlich Thanasis that embodies the Acuity of the Lich.

name: Spirit Wolf

name: Spirit Spider

name: Spirit Chicken

name: Spirit Eagle
